summary: The comment supports maintaining the current E-Rate program as it is, emphasizing the importance of affordable high-speed internet access for libraries to provide essential services to their patrons.

claims.requested_action: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: Affordable high-speed internet is essential for libraries to provide excellent services to patrons who rely on them for internet access
claims.evidence_quote: Having an affordable high-quality internet access is meaningful to library patrons who rely on the library for internet access, and allows the library to provide excellent service to patrons.
